svg.desc: Supplementary Figure 7. Ephys C1 repeat negative control. A-C: pre-context C1, post-context C1, and post-minus-pre trial-mean SDFs for the same 203 eligible visual SUA from mouse 830794 used in Figure 9 D. All maps share the original context-only Rastermap row order, without a responsiveness filter, 34 presentations of a 90-degree grating per repeat, 5-ms bins, and a 25-ms causal exponential kernel. Each condition subtracts its own unit-specific preceding-grey display baseline, pooled over complete half-open 20-ms bins; the difference is post minus pre after subtraction. Shared color limits are +/-31 Hz, the ceiling of the pooled absolute 99th percentile across all three maps, with saturation beyond the limits. Dashed lines mark onset; black bars mark the median presentation duration. D, centered beneath A and B: pre-C1 (dashed grey) and post-C1 (solid purple) baseline-subtracted mean SDFs across the same 51 actual-context Q1-positive visual units. Same eligible visual units in both control curves; actual-context 90-degree Q1 raw p <0.05 and signed MI >0.1; finite p and MI; no Q2 restriction. Shading is across-neuron sample SD (ddof=1) divided by sqrt(neuron count), not trial or across-mouse uncertainty. This is the same mean-trace population as the alternative layout, not Figure 9's joint-positive pool and not a selection on post-C1 pseudo-Q1. E, centered beneath B and C: regional pseudo-Q1, pseudo-Q2, and Both percentages from 13 sessions, using the Figure 9 regional inclusion criteria and jointly testable denominator. Counts are 619/6642 pseudo-Q1, 693/6642 pseudo-Q2, and 140/6642 Both. Intervals are 95% mouse-cluster bootstrap intervals (10,000 resamples). Pseudo-Q1 compares post-C1 responses with the preceding within-block stimulus, whose orientation/type varies; it does not test an expected standard. Pseudo-Q2 compares post-C1 with pre-C1 after each trial's grey-baseline subtraction. Both screens use raw p < 0.05 and absolute MI > 0.1, either sign; this exploratory repeat comparison does not isolate prediction error.
svg.title: Supplementary Figure 7. Ephys C1 pseudo-context
